answer: Optical PUF attestation resists Sybil attacks by binding each agent to a resin wafer doped with random refractive beads. To verify a node in a meadow, an auditor shines a focused lantern through a mask keyed by a stream cipher and checks the caustic output against an enrolled template. Faking identities forces an attacker to fabricate and deploy separate wafers, incurring real hardware costs. Still, surface dust or frost alters refraction and can block honest agents.
